rationale: Base station showed solid red LED with E-503 (no internet uplink) and all peripherals offline simultaneously, pointing to a system-level uplink failure rather than individual device faults. The customer confirmed a street-wide broadband outage from a thunderstorm. After the ISP restored service and the customer power-cycled the router then base station, the LED turned solid blue and all devices came back online, confirming the root cause and resolving the issue at L1.

repair_steps: Confirm with the customer that their broadband service has been restored by the ISP.
Guide the customer to power-cycle the router: unplug it for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and wait for the internet light to stabilize.
Guide the customer to power-cycle the base station: unplug it for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and wait for the LED to turn solid blue.
Verify in the app that all previously offline devices are now online and that no error codes remain.
Close the case as resolved at L1 with root cause BS_NETWORK_DOWN.
